$comment: A3 authoritative role -> Key Vault named-value alias mapping. A2's named-value DISPLAY NAMES MUST set-equal the aliases here (G1b gate). A4's broker-policy.xml MUST select the named value by exact array membership on the role claim (G2 gate). A5 MUST assign the workload SP a DIRECT app-role assignment to one of these roles (no group nesting). Values are stable across all waves.

roles.description: Allows the caller to invoke the vendor API using the Team A vendor key (named value vendor-key-a).
roles.intendedCallers: Team A users and Team A CI workload service principals

roles.description: Allows the caller to invoke the vendor API using the Team B vendor key (named value vendor-key-b).
roles.intendedCallers: Team B users and Team B CI workload service principals

delegatedScope.adminConsentDescription: Allows the caller to invoke the vendor API through the broker; key selection is enforced server-side by the caller's app role.
delegatedScope.userConsentDescription: Invoke the vendor API through the broker (no vendor key exposure).
